name: Code Geass ~Hangyaku no Lelouch~ Lost Colors
original_name: コードギアス 反逆のルルーシュ　LOST COLORS
source: The story begins after episode 8 of the anime. you play as Rai, another young boy with a geass ability, who ends up at Ashford Academy after losing his memories.
translation: 故事从动画第8集之后开始。玩家将扮演莱，一名同样拥有Geass能力的少年。他在失去记忆后辗转来到阿什弗德学园。
